name: RackNerd KVM VPS
line: Run KVM virtual servers with root access and customer managed software.

cells.regions: 12 KVM sites: US, Canada, Europe (France city unclear)

work.math: $17.99 a month is the known server charge. The 1,000 GB transfer is listed against 100 GB of data sent out, but the direction, extra charges, tax and domain costs are unclear.
The $17.99 a month server has 2 vCores, 1,024 MB of RAM, 50 GB of SSD and 1,000 GB of transfer. Whether 100 GB sent out fits has not been tested, and tax is not included.

$24.59 a month is the hosting subtotal for the app and a Postgres database you manage yourself. Daily backup storage kept off the network and tax are extra. Whether the workload fits has not been tested.
